lines.japanese: 一時間目の休み時間。
lines.english: The break after first period.

lines.japanese: 「はぁーっ……」
lines.english: “Siiiiigh...”

lines.japanese: 俺は慣れないお勉強に精気を奪われ、硬い椅子の上でぐってりしていました。
lines.english: Unaccustomed study had drained my life force, leaving me limp in my hard chair.

lines.japanese: ああ疲れた。もうやだ。５０分も机でじっとしてるの肩がこる。
lines.english: Ah, I was tired. I hated this. Sitting still at a desk for fifty minutes made my shoulders ache.

lines.japanese: ああそうだ、三学期になったら受験生はほぼ自由登校らしいから、形だけでも進学志望のふりをしようかしら。
lines.english: Oh, right. Apparently, students preparing for entrance exams were mostly free to choose whether they attended during the third term. Maybe I should at least pretend I intended to continue my education.

lines.japanese: なんてセコいことを考えていると、スカートのポケットに両手を突っこんだチンピラみたいなプリンセスが、のしのしと近づいてきました。
lines.english: As I entertained that miserly thought, a princess resembling a street thug lumbered toward me with both hands stuffed into her skirt pockets.

lines.japanese: 「ちょー。ちょーちょー」
lines.english: “Hey. Hey, hey.”

lines.japanese: うわ、態度わるっ。
lines.english: Wow. What an attitude.

lines.japanese: 「いや、ちょーちょーじゃなくて。アナタね、俺に用があるなら、普通に名前を呼んでくださいよ」
lines.english: “No, not ‘hey, hey.’ If you need something from me, call my name like a normal person.”

lines.japanese: 「名前？　なんて？」
lines.english: “Your name? What's that?”

lines.japanese: いまさらする質問ですかソレ。
lines.english: Was that truly a question she needed to ask now?

lines.japanese: まあ、たしかに、このひとから今までなんらかの名称で呼ばれた覚えはなかったですけど。
lines.english: Then again, I could not recall her ever addressing me by any kind of name.

lines.japanese: 「何度も言ってるとおり、対外的には羽田鷹志だから『羽田君』でいいですってば」
lines.english: “As I keep telling you, to the outside world I'm Takashi Haneda, so ‘Haneda’ is fine.”

lines.japanese: 「却下」
lines.english: “Rejected.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、べつにお伺いを立ててるわけじゃないんで。事実『羽田君』なんで」
lines.english: “I wasn't asking your permission. I am, in fact, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「図々しい。盗っ人猛々しいとは、まさにこのことだ」
lines.english: “Shameless. The thief grows bold, indeed.”

lines.japanese: 「盗っ人て。傷付くなあ」
lines.english: “A thief? That hurts.”

lines.japanese: 「盗まれたこっちはもっと傷付いてるんですけど」
lines.english: “It hurts the person you stole him from more.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、いますねえ、失くしてから気付くひと。彼のこと、そんなに好きだったんですか」
lines.english: “Ah, yes. Some people don't know what they had until it's gone. Did you really like him that much?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、べつに？　まあ、そんな、言うほどじゃないよね」
lines.english: “No, not especially. I mean, not enough to make a big deal of it.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあもういいじゃないですか。アナタ若いんだから、次行きましょ次。新しいオトコ上書きして、前の恋ささっと忘れましょう」
lines.english: “Then let it go. You're young. Move on to the next man. Overwrite the old one with somebody new and forget your former love.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと待て。だから恋ではないんだってば」
lines.english: “Wait. I told you it wasn't love.”

lines.japanese: 「まだ言うんかい、認めえやもう。ええ加減にしなさい」
lines.english: “Still saying that? Just admit it already. Enough is enough.”

lines.japanese: ぺちっ。
lines.english: Smack.

lines.japanese: 「ハイ。どーもありがとうございましたー」
lines.english: “Thank you, ladies and gentlemen!”

lines.japanese: ひとネタ終わると明日香さんは下手へ退場して、そのまま戻ってきませんでした。
lines.english: With our comedy bit complete, Asuka exited stage left and did not return.

lines.japanese: なにか俺に用事があったわけではないようです。
lines.english: Apparently, she had not actually needed anything from me.

lines.japanese: 暇なのかな、あのひと。
lines.english: Was she bored?

lines.japanese: 二時間目の休み時間。
lines.english: The break after second period.

lines.japanese: ふたたび俺がぐってりしていると、ふたたびガラの悪いプリンセスがやってきました。
lines.english: Once again, I slumped at my desk, and once again, the ill-mannered princess approached.

lines.japanese: 「おー。おーおー」
lines.english: “Yo. Yo, yo.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、おーじゃなくて。アナタね、どうしても『羽田君』って言いたくないなら、せめて『俺の』名前で呼んでくださいよ」
lines.english: “No, not ‘yo.’ If you refuse to call me Haneda, at least call me by *my* name.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんてったっけ名前ー」
lines.english: “Huh? What was your name again?”

lines.japanese: んまあ！　何度も耳にしてるくせして白々しいお嬢さんだわ。
lines.english: Well! She had heard it countless times. What a brazen young lady.

lines.japanese: 「朝でも夜でもコンバンワ。千歳ぬるぬる鷲介と申します。どうぞお見知りおきを」
lines.english: “Good evening, morning or night. I am Shuusuke ‘Slippery’ Chitose. Delighted to make your acquaintance.”

lines.japanese: 「あー」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese: 何その覚える気まったくない返事。
lines.english: What was that answer completely devoid of any intention to remember?

lines.japanese: 「親しみを込めてシュウちゃんと呼んでいただいても結構っすよ」
lines.english: “Feel free to call me Shuu if you’d like to be more friendly.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃー、まー、機会があれば」
lines.english: “Sure. If the occasion arises.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと」
lines.english: “You what?”

lines.japanese: 「マーベラス！」
lines.english: “Marvelous!”

lines.japanese: 「そういう日もある」
lines.english: “Some days are like that.”

lines.japanese: なぜか互いの物真似大合戦を始める俺たちでした。
lines.english: For some reason, we launched into a furious exchange of impressions.

lines.japanese: 「日和子すゎ～ん、今日のパンツ何色っすか～」
lines.english: “Hiyoko, what color panties are you wearing today?”

lines.japanese: 「うせやん、そんなん言うたことないわ。ええ加減にしなさい」
lines.english: “As if! I've never said anything like that. Enough is enough.”

lines.japanese: ぺちっ。
lines.english: Smack.

lines.japanese: 「ども、ありがとうございましたー」
lines.english: “Thank you, ladies and gentlemen!”

lines.japanese: そして明日香さんは退場した。
lines.english: And Asuka made her exit.

lines.japanese: 今回もとくに用事があったわけではないようです。
lines.english: Once again, she apparently had not needed anything.

lines.japanese: 友達いないのかな、あのひと。
lines.english: Did she have no friends?

lines.japanese: 三時間目は、担当教諭不在につき自習でした。
lines.english: Our third period was self-study because the teacher was absent.

lines.japanese: 受験生だらけのクラスですから、けっこう真面目にお勉強している生徒さんが多いです。
lines.english: With a class full of students preparing for entrance exams, quite a few were studying seriously.

lines.japanese: なにしろ決戦間近のこの時期。悪名高い昌子さんグループでさえ教科書ノートを開いておいでです。
lines.english: The decisive hour was near. Even the notorious Masako clique had textbooks and notebooks open.

lines.japanese: それに引きかえ羽田班の皆さんときたら、二名が保健室へ。残り一名も実に実に暇そうで──
lines.english: The members of the Haneda group, meanwhile, were another story. Two had gone to the nurse's office, while the last looked profoundly, profoundly bored—

lines.japanese: 「ワシー。鷲、鷲ー」
lines.english: “Eagle. Hey, Eagle!”

lines.japanese: ──ああ、やっぱり暇だったみたいです。案の定こっち来ましたねえ。
lines.english: —yes, she really had been bored. Here she came, exactly as expected.

lines.japanese: 「いや、ワシじゃなくて。さっき教えたでしょう、ひとの名前ぐらいちゃんと覚えてくださいよ」
lines.english: “Not Eagle. I just told you—at least remember a guy’s name.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだっけ、わしのすけ？」
lines.english: “What was it, Eaglenosuke?”

lines.japanese: 「惜しい。之は要りません」
lines.english: “Close. Drop the ‘no.’”

lines.japanese: 「わしすけ？」
lines.english: “Eaglesuke?”

lines.japanese: 「鷲と書いてシュウって読むんですよ」
lines.english: “It’s ‘Shuu,’ not ‘Eagle.’ Shuu-suke.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、しゅうのすけ？」
lines.english: “Then... Shuunosuke?”

lines.japanese: 「之はいらないってさっき言ったでしょ」
lines.english: “I just said to lose the ‘no.’”

lines.japanese: 「わしすけ？」
lines.english: “Eaglesuke?”

lines.japanese: 「なんで戻っとんねん。もうええわ」
lines.english: “Why'd you go backward? Forget it.”

lines.japanese: ぺちっ。
lines.english: Smack.

lines.japanese: 「どーも、ありがとーございましたー」
lines.english: “Thank you, ladies and gentlemen!”

lines.japanese: そして明日香さんは去った。
lines.english: And Asuka left.

lines.japanese: やっぱり用事はなかったみたいです。
lines.english: It appeared she had never needed anything.

lines.japanese: ほんとに人間嫌いなのかな、あのひと。
lines.english: Did she truly hate people?

lines.japanese: そして三時間目の休み時間。
lines.english: Then came the break after third period.

lines.japanese: 相変わらず俺がぐってりしていると、相変わらず態度の悪いプリンセスがやってきました。
lines.english: As ever, I lay slumped at my desk. As ever, the princess with the bad attitude approached.

lines.japanese: 「ちょー、おー、わしー」
lines.english: “Hey. Yo. Eagle.”

lines.japanese: 「学習機能ゼロ！？」
lines.english: “You have no capacity for learning?!”

lines.japanese: 「あーなんだっけ、そこの鷲っぽい名前の……ワシントン？」
lines.english: “What was it? That guy with the eagle-ish name... Washington?”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさいお父さん、桜の枝を折ったのは僕です……ってオイ。誰がアメリカ合衆国初代大統領ですか」
lines.english: “I'm sorry, Father. I broke the cherry-tree branch... Hey! Who're you calling the first president of the United States?”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあジェファーソン？」
lines.english: “Then Jefferson?”

lines.japanese: 「いいから。二代目大統領もいいから」
lines.english: “Enough presidents. I don't need the second one either.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、三代目です」
lines.english: “He was the third.”

lines.japanese: 「アッ！　いまのちょっと日和子さんっぽい！」
lines.english: “Oh! That sounded a little like Hiyoko!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。そんなことより仕事してください。くいくい」
lines.english: “Sigh. More importantly, please do your work. *Push, push.*”

lines.japanese: 「ひ、日和子さんだ、日和子さんが眼鏡をくいくいしている……！」
lines.english: “H-Hiyoko! Hiyoko is pushing her glasses up...!”

lines.japanese: 「どうもー、玉泉どすー。玉はなくとも玉泉どすー」
lines.english: “Hellooo, Tamaizumi here. Tama means balls, but I got none at all!”

lines.japanese: 「ひよちゃん下ネタとか言わない」
lines.english: “My Hiyo doesn't make dirty jokes.”

lines.japanese: 「エッ！？　やだ、あいつ、彼氏の前だとそういうキャラなの……？」
lines.english: “What?! No way. Is that how she acts in front of her boyfriend...?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと！　やめてくださいよ、その白々しいウソ驚き！」
lines.english: “Hey! Stop that blatantly fake surprise!”

lines.japanese: 「だって、おかしいな、女子だけのときは普通に……アッううん、なんでもないの。聞かなかったことにしてあげて」
lines.english: “But that’s strange. When it’s only girls, she normally... Oh! No, never mind. Do her a favor and forget you heard that.”

lines.japanese: 「猿芝居やめェェェーっ！　ホント名誉棄損で訴えますよォォォ！？」
lines.english: “Enough of this lousy act! I'll sue you for defamation!”

lines.japanese: 「はい、ごめんなさい。本当は、桜の枝を折ったのも玉泉なんです」
lines.english: “Yes, I'm sorry. Tamaizumi broke the cherry-tree branch too.”

lines.japanese: 「だから戻らんでええっちゅーに。もうアンタとはやってられんわ」
lines.english: “You didn't have to go back to that! I can't work with you anymore.”

lines.japanese: びしっ。
lines.english: Thwack.

lines.japanese: 「ども、失礼しましたー」
lines.english: “Thank you and good night!”

lines.japanese: そして明日香さんは去った。
lines.english: And Asuka left.

lines.japanese: 相変わらず用事はなかったみたいです。
lines.english: As ever, she apparently had not needed anything.

lines.japanese: 意外と寂しがり屋さんなのかな、あのひと。
lines.english: Perhaps she was lonelier than she looked.
